steps.name: create-branch
steps.description: Create task/t0123_bedb_mi_atp_per_spike_nsga2 branch from main and plan the step list.

steps.name: init-folders
steps.description: Create mandatory task folder structure with assets/predictions/ and assets/answer/ subfolders.

steps.name: research-papers
steps.description: Skipped: Strong 1998, Sengupta 2010, Carter-Bean 2009, Niven 2007, Dhingra-Smith 2004, Attwell-Laughlin 2001, Remme 2018 already in the corpus via t0097's catalogue (which gave explicit MI + ATP recipes).

steps.name: research-internet
steps.description: Skipped: no external information required beyond what t0097 already collected; MI and ATP recipes are fully specified in the catalogue.

steps.name: research-code
steps.description: Review t0122 evaluator/recorder/cytoplasm_volume.py (most-recent NSGA-II template to fork), t0091 trial_helpers, t0097's MI + ATP recipes, t0115 NSGA-II driver, and existing libraries for MI estimators (sklearn.metrics.mutual_info_score, npeet).

steps.name: planning
steps.description: Design fork of t0122 substrate: add per-segment seg.ina recording, ATP-per-spike calculator, spike-count MI estimator, post-hoc Strong-Bialek direct-method MI rerun. Plan ATP recipe smoke gate vs Carter-Bean 2009 before NSGA-II launches.

steps.name: setup-machines
steps.description: Provision single Vast.ai EPYC instance (32-core or 64-core, cheapest at provisioning time) following t0122's protocol; gated on Vast.ai balance >= $7.

steps.name: implementation
steps.description: Run NSGA-II to gen 60 ceiling or $6 cost cap. Then rerun top-10 cells with 8-direction * 20-trial protocol for post-hoc Strong-Bialek direct-method MI.

steps.name: teardown
steps.description: Destroy Vast.ai instance immediately after implementation. Update machine_log.json, remote_machines_used.json, costs.json.

steps.name: creative-thinking
steps.description: Skipped: recipes are fully specified in the t0097 catalogue; no out-of-the-box analysis needed beyond the planned comparison to Niven 2007.

steps.name: results
steps.description: Write results_summary.md, results_detailed.md, metrics.json, costs.json. Build Pareto + Niven-2007-comparison + Carter-Bean-ATP-check charts. Build top-50 morphology grid (full dendrite trees).

steps.name: compare-literature
steps.description: Write compare_literature.md comparing top-10 (bits/s, ATP/spike) front to Niven 2007 fly-photoreceptor curve, Strong 1998 H1 ceiling, Dhingra-Smith 2004 RGC graded-vs-spike loss, Sengupta 2010 cross-cell-type ranges, Carter-Bean 2009 ATP/AP benchmark.

steps.name: suggestions
steps.description: Generate follow-up task suggestions in results/suggestions.json (max 5 per kind, deduplicated against existing active suggestions).

steps.name: reporting
steps.description: Run all verificators, capture sessions, set task.json status=completed.
